overview: Two-arm cluster randomised trial in 11 general practices over 12 months, comparing a dental pain pathway with usual care, using routinely coded data.
population: All consultations by adults aged 16 or over coded for dental pain, toothache, dental abscess or facial swelling of dental origin in the 11 practices from January to December 2027.
exposure: Intervention practices: a one-page decision aid in the clinical system, a same-day telephone triage line run by the community dental service, and a printed analgesia advice sheet. Control practices: usual care.
procedures: Practices are allocated by a statistician outside the network, stratified by list size and deprivation fifth. The data team extracts coded consultations, prescriptions within 3 days and emergency attendances monthly. A safety group reviews emergency admissions for dental infection every three months.

outcomes.name: Antibiotic prescription for dental pain
outcomes.measure: Proportion of dental pain consultations followed by an antibiotic prescription within 3 days

outcomes.name: Repeat consultation
outcomes.measure: Further GP consultation for the same problem within 14 days

outcomes.name: Emergency attendance or admission for dental infection
outcomes.measure: Emergency department attendance or admission coded for dental infection within 14 days

outcomes.name: Triage line use
outcomes.measure: Calls to the triage line per 100 dental pain consultations in intervention practices
outcomes.why: Shows whether the pathway was used.

feasibility: About 1,500 dental pain consultations are expected across 11 practices in 12 months; routine extraction needs no practice staff time beyond the data team.
biasMitigation: Allocation concealed and done outside the network
Outcomes from coded data, not clinician report
Safety review independent of the investigators

biasFlags.label: Few clusters
biasFlags.note: Eleven practices; small-sample correction and stratification.

biasFlags.label: Coding variation
biasFlags.note: Practices may code dental pain differently; code lists fixed in advance.

parsimony.simplestPath: One primary outcome from routine data, one balancing measure with safety review.

theoreticalFramework: None beyond the TIDieR description of the pathway.
summary: Cluster trial with one primary outcome, one secondary, one balancing and one process measure.
